text:
Samira: hi team :wave: just received my company MBP (16" M2). Trying to enroll in Company Portal but it shows 'Enrollment pending' and FileVault failed with 'FileVault enable failed (4922)'. Need Rosetta & Homebrew for my dev tools. Who do I ping for a short admin push?

IT Help: welcome Samira! Can you try signing out/in of Company Portal first? If that doesn't clear it, paste outputs of `profiles status -type enrollment` and `fdesetup status` here. We'll re-trigger enrollment if needed.

Samira: pasted outputs: `profiles: There are no configuration profiles installed.` and `fdesetup status: FileVault is Off`. System Settings UI shows FileVault Enabled though. macOS 13.6.1 (22G260).

jack-ops: I can re-trigger enrollment and push a temporary admin token (standard 60-min sudo). We don't grant permanent admin. Want me to do that now?

Samira: yes please, 60 minutes should be enough to install Rosetta, Homebrew, Docker.

jack-ops: pushing enrollment + admin for 60m now. You should get a macOS notification and Company Portal prompt. After accepting, run:

`softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license`
`/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"`

Also re-run `profiles status -type enrollment` and `fdesetup status` to confirm.

MDM Bot: Enrollment re-triggered by jack-ops for device serial ending XXXXX123. Status: pending.

jack-ops: Admin push is active. Run `sudo -v` to verify. If FileVault shows conflicting state after these steps we'll escalate to imaging/Apple support.

Samira: got the admin prompt :tada: Rosetta and Homebrew installed, Docker installed too. `fdesetup status` now returns: FileVault is On. I think it finished after the re-trigger. Rebooting to be safe.

Diana: FYI you may see Spotlight re-indexing and higher disk IO while FileVault completes encryption. That's normal. If brew taps are blocked, ping #devx for preapproved taps. Onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/devx/onboarding/basics

People Ops: Welcome Samira! :tada: Ping us to schedule your team intro 1:1s.

Samira: all good now, thanks @jack-ops and everyone :rocket:
